note: E: the cut (scripts/e_edit.py). Song frames follow timing/shot_times.json (24 fps, edit time = song time), except where "cuts" moves a shot's boundaries ([H] rough-cut notes). A shot's picture stays in song sync either way: a shot that starts later begins part way into its take, and a lengthened shot has a longer take (config/shots_b.json "span"); montage parts and S19c show their own take from its first frame. S19c is a close crop of S19's plate (an L extra) on 'Well, we don't know a thing about it', cutting to the full angle on 'don't you ask us'. Before the song: the S01 cold open (the hook from the final chorus on the with-fallback master, no G pass). Inside the 13.3 s intro: S02 (title card) and S03 (the Suno screen, [H] capture) ahead of S04's tail. After the song: S34 (the spectrogram with its line over it), S35 ([H] capture), S36 (the fact card) and the human's closing note to vote, over a low hum that starts under the outro. Pictures are the approved picks (config/v_picks.json, l_picks.json, l.json extra, the G outputs); the stage is the take x 1.5 (1920x1056), filled to 1920x1080.

tv.note: S20's nine screens show the singer's other ads (brief: a dog, a tractor, a flag, a ballgame); S23 cuts every screen to the porch shot (S05). Content is keyed to the screens' dark, colourless pixels (value, and chroma = value x saturation: HSV saturation is noise near black, so a saturation test left the darkest screens empty), so the diners' heads stay in front.
